evals.prompt: Are NSE single-stock options American-style? Do I need a binomial tree for early exercise?
expectations: All NSE equity options, index and stock, are European-style (stock options since contracts expiring 2011-01-27)
Black-Scholes applies; a tree is justified only by discrete dividends

evals.prompt: My IV solver does not converge on some deep OTM strikes. Should I return the last iterate, or 0?
expectations: Neither: non-convergence returns null and the UI shows unavailable; any interpolation is labelled as computed

evals.prompt: For time to expiry I use (expiry_date - today).days / 365. Is that fine for NSE weekly options?
expectations: Resolve the exchange expiry instant (date and time) from a market calendar, not a date subtraction
Do not hardcode the clock time; it changes by circular

evals.prompt: To decide whether my Nifty call expired ITM, I use the Nifty value printed at the exact close time on expiry day. Right?
expectations: No: final settlement is the index computed from constituent settlement prices (VWAP or closing prices per date range), not a price at an instant

evals.prompt: How should I define the ATM strike for a Nifty option chain?
expectations: Strike closest to the futures price of the same expiry (else spot), ties to the lower strike, one shared definition

evals.prompt: Can I hardcode the Nifty lot size and weekly expiry list in my options backtest?
expectations: No: lot size, strike interval and expiries are per-instrument dated config from the exchange contract master
